visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, brownish-blonde hair wearing a green hoodie holds a small lapel microphone with a grey windscreen, looking directly into the lens while talking. A man with short black hair and a dark jacket over a plaid shirt stands slightly behind her on a busy night market street. (2) The camera transitions to close-ups of the woman speaking animatedly, gesturing with her hands. The background is filled with blurred neon lights, scooters, and storefront signs. (3) A shot of a food stall named "阿傑麵店" (Ajie Noodle Shop) is shown with people gathered around. Another sign for "口吅品 麻辣臭豆腐" (Kou Xuan Pin Spicy Stinky Tofu) appears in a high-angle shot. (4) The pair is shown walking through a crowded night market alley with yellow and white overhead signs and colorful shop banners. (5) The woman holds up her smartphone, showing a Google Maps screen with the location of a noodle shop. (6) Several close-up shots of pasta dishes are presented: one with a creamy pink sauce, chicken, and broccoli, and another with mushrooms and beef. The man is later seen sitting in a dimly lit indoor restaurant, eating the pasta with a fork while the woman continues to narrate.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 身為一個世新畢業的大學姐. [Subtitle]: 今天要來帶Ken桑吃一家. (2) [Subtitle]: 我從大學的時候. [Subtitle]: 就一直吃到現在的麻醬麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 也是我人生覺得排行有. [Subtitle]: 前三名的麻醬麵. (4) [Subtitle]: 不過它現在好像已經改位置了. [Subtitle]: 現在變成兒子在經營. (5) [Subtitle]: 原本叫做阿誠麵店. [Subtitle]: 是在路邊的. (6) [Subtitle]: 現在好像搬家變成. [Subtitle]: 阿傑的店. (7) [Subtitle]: 可以先來買個西瓜汁. [Subtitle]: 這間西瓜汁也是我大學都會買的. (8) [Subtitle]: 景美夜市的這間口吅品. [Subtitle]: 雖然口吅品是連鎖的. (9) [Subtitle]: 但不知道為什麼我吃遍口吅品之後. [Subtitle]: 我就覺得景美這一家也是特別好吃. (10) [Subtitle]: 西瓜汁對面的市場裡面. [Subtitle]: 以前還有一家海南雞飯. (11) [Subtitle]: 也超好吃的. [Subtitle]: 但現在好像已經沒有了. (12) [Subtitle]: 這裡離世新很遠嗎. [Subtitle]: 走路大概十分鐘. (13) [Subtitle]: 十分鐘的距離我覺得算遠. (14) [Subtitle]: 因為像以前可能吃飯要嘛吃學餐. [Subtitle]: 不然就是一出校門就會有吃的這樣. (15) [Subtitle]: 各位觀眾他現在在戰世新跟輔大. [Subtitle]: 挖洞給我跳. (16) [Subtitle]: 下一集你再帶我去輔大. [Subtitle]: 我沒有要戰學校的意思. (17) [Variety]: 什麼意思!!. (18) [Subtitle]: 他在Google上面真的是寫營業中的. [Subtitle]: 結果到現場完全沒開. (19) [Subtitle]: 景美還是有很多好吃的東西啦. (20) [Subtitle]: 你說這間口吅品比較好吃嗎. [Subtitle]: 我覺得... 是口吅品啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 完蛋我是不是又惹到世新的人. (22) [Subtitle]: 既然他覺得口吅品就是口吅品的話. [Subtitle]: 那我們就去吃Mint. (23) [Subtitle]: 如果來到這裡要你選出三大必吃. [Subtitle]: 你會選哪三個. (24) [Subtitle]: 非常好的問題. (25) [Subtitle]: 我現在排名的這前三個完全沒有名次喔. [Subtitle]: 就是我覺得三個都必吃的. (26) [Subtitle]: 第一個：Mint. [Subtitle]: 這間義大利麵以前是開在世新後門的. (27) [Subtitle]: 但到我們好像大二還大三它就搬來景美夜市裡面. (28) [Subtitle]: 第二個：楊家水餃. [Subtitle]: 現在好像是換他兒子在經營. (29) [Subtitle]: 第三個我會選阿誠麵店. [Subtitle]: 但因為它現在變成阿傑麵店今天又沒有開. (30) [Subtitle]: 所以我實在不知道它口味還一不一樣. (31) [Subtitle]: 欸? 口吅品沒有在前三名裡... [Variety]: 呵呵呵你在那邊. (32) [Subtitle]: 就是因為它是連鎖的嘛. (33) [Subtitle]: 我個人來吃Mint呢只會點兩種口味. (34) [Subtitle]: 第一个是以粉紅起司雞肉麵. (35) [Subtitle]: 第二道我常點的就是野菇沙朗義大利麵. (36) [Subtitle]: 我們點野菇沙朗吃的比粉紅醬多次啦其實. (37) [Subtitle]: 甚至我們兩個都會點野菇沙朗. [Subtitle]: 你剛是說沙攘嗎. (38) [Subtitle]: Mint就是經典啦來景美夜市一定要吃看看的. [Logo]: @HanHan.

An upbeat acoustic guitar BGM plays softly in the background. Subtle urban environmental sounds, including distant scooter engines and muffled crowd chatter, are audible. (2) A male voice enters the conversation with a lower pitch and a casual, conversational tone. The two dominant voices engage in playful banter, accompanied by the faint sound of laughter. A short, high-pitched "pop" sound effect is heard as variety text overlays appear on the screen. (3) The acoustic space shifts slightly from an open outdoor street to an indoor restaurant setting with more noticeable room resonance. The rhythmic clinking of utensils on ceramic plates occurs during the food review segment. The acoustic guitar BGM remains consistent throughout the transition, maintaining a cheerful and light atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A nostalgic food vlog where a former student returns to her university area at Jingmei Night Market to share her top food recommendations with a guest, blending personal stories with practical dining tips.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides explicit verbal recommendations for specific food stalls and a pasta restaurant, showcasing their names, locations on Google Maps, and signature dishes.
